root_cause: No execution grounding: drafts fail silently on literal case/padding drift, wrong filter/join column, one-sided anti-joins and over-narrow projections
what: Add a single verify-and-repair stage to solve.py: execute the draft read-only, collect deterministic diagnostics (0-row results with literal probes against real cell values via LIKE/trim/case-insensitive matching, per-predicate row counts, symmetric anti-join checks) and send them plus schema/question/hint in one repair call; also add prompt rules for SELECT * on entity questions, case-insensitive LIKE for text filters, both sides of friend-style relations, and exact hint literals. This targets all five failures without touching extract_sql or removing any guard.

root_cause: Drafts are never executed, so silently-wrong queries (0-row literal/format drift, narrow projections) ship unchanged
what: Add an execution-grounded verify-and-repair stage: run the draft SQL and only when it errors or returns zero rows, spend the second policy call on a repair prompt containing the error/row count plus bounded probe results (LIKE variants for each string literal, value samples of filtered columns). Also extend the system prompt with general rules about padded/case-drifted literals, 'details'-style questions selecting all columns, and symmetric anti-joins.
decision: It delivers a clear +6.7pt gain (83.33→90.0) with zero broken tasks, and the execution-grounded verify-and-repair mechanism is general rather than task-specific; the earlier r0 s2 drop was for an undeclared extract_sql rewrite that this version's diff no longer contains, and the added ~292 tokens/task are justified by the size of the gain.

root_cause: Repair triggers only on error/zero rows, so silently-wrong drafts (duplicate rows from multi-row joins, over-narrow projections) ship unchanged
what: Extend the verify stage with one deterministic duplicate-row check: if the executed draft returns repeated identical rows (a join fan-out signal), spend the second policy call asking whether the question implies distinct entities (add DISTINCT / EXISTS) and to re-check projection width against the question. Also add a prompt guideline that entity-list questions joined through multi-row relations need DISTINCT while per-record questions keep duplicates.

root_cause: Repair triggers only on execution errors / zero rows, so silently-wrong but non-empty results (fan-out duplicates from joining through a 1:N link table, narrow projections) are never re-examined
what: Extend the existing verify-and-repair stage with one deterministic signal: if the draft executes with >0 rows and its result contains exact duplicate rows while the SQL has no DISTINCT/GROUP BY/UNION, spend the second policy call asking the model to reconsider join fan-out vs genuine multiplicity (dedupe only if duplicates are artifacts). This targets sp0536 (8 rows with repeated names vs gold 5) without touching literal probes or the prompt; DISTINCT/GROUP BY drafts are skipped so already-correct queries are unaffected.
